redundant_explanations.method: Count later full treatments of active-account eligibility, the Polish shopper threshold and the Irish merchant threshold. Each is repeated across four baseline sections (three excess explanations per rule). The final revised document has one detailed treatment of each rule; brief summary navigation and generic process routing are locally useful and excluded by the preregistered rubric.

measurement_limits: Agent assessment of ten annotated passages, not independent human scoring or proof of semantic perfection on larger corpora. Word counts exclude URL syntax and citation labels but include Mermaid source words. The final writing run overlapped furniture-quality-v8, so wall time is an observation, not an isolated benchmark.

reader_question_assessments.answer: PLN 500 per order applies to shoppers in Poland; EUR 500 per order applies to merchants in Ireland. Orders above either applicable limit require manual specialist approval.
Legal hold extends availability beyond 30 days. The deletion date after the hold ends is unspecified.
Incomplete submissions go to Needs correction and return to the submitting role. Resubmission with missing details returns to Submitted and repeats validation.
Only a specialist can approve Manual review. A rejection path is not documented.
Review hands the approved order identifier to Fulfilment, which records Queued. There is no stated delivery-time guarantee.
The submitting role, decision and time are recorded for every approval; specialists can inspect history; retention is unspecified.
